newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar ends slightly weaker in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar ends slightly weaker in quiet trade.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed slightly weaker in quiet trade on Tuesday, with exporter interest balanced by some profit-taking.
The Kiwi finished at US$0.6900/10 and 67.78 on its Trade-Weighted Index, from 0.6906/13 and 67.79 at the opening. It traded a range of 0.6898-0.6915 on the day.
Dealers said U.S. sentiment towards the Kiwi was bearish following last week's falls, and that had also been reflected lately in selling of New Zealand bonds.
US$0.6880 was still seen as a key support level, with one dealer picking a range of 0.6880-6930 overnight.
